question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

If the linguistic minority refuses to vote, it may __rock the boat__.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Upset the balance'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined idiom **"rock the boat" **refers to an action causing trouble or disturbing a situation or plan that is already running smoothly. It implies disrupting the status quo or causing instability. **("स्थिति को व्यवधानित करना").**

 
 
• **For example, **"After Robert was hired, he made a lot of changes to the procedures, which definitely **rocked the boat**."
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Lead to protests' **means causing or resulting in objections or public displays of disapproval. ("विरोध की ओर ले जाना").
 
• **'Topple the government' **refers to overthrowing or unseating the ruling authority or administration. ("सरकार को गिराना").
 
• **'Restore the equilibrium'** means bringing back the balance or steadiness in something. ("समानता को बहाल करना").
